_readme: REFERENCE FILE ONLY. projects.html reads data/projects.json, not this file.
Copy the shape below into data/projects.json and replace every value.
Use only these category values if you want the filter buttons to stay tidy:
Financial Analysis, Stock Analysis, M&A, Valuation, Portfolio Analysis,
title        (required) Project title, exactly as on the detail page.
slug         (required) The detail page filename, without '.html'.
Leave 'url' empty and the title renders as plain text.
category     (required) One of the categories listed above.
summary      (required) One sentence. This is what recruiters read first.
url          (optional) Path to the detail page, e.g. 'projects/my-project.html'.
links        (optional) Any of: pdf, repo, external. Delete the ones you do not use.
confidential (optional) true if the write-up is anonymised. Defaults to false.
Newest first: the list is rendered in the order it appears in the file.

projects.title: [Project title]
projects.summary: [One-sentence summary of the project — what it examined and what it found.]
